<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex61122023-09-13-102" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon verse (77b4-78a8)"/>
         <lg><l>ding sang thub bstan <pb n="78a"/><lb n="78a1"/> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">gangs ri'i khrod</rs> 'dir dar ||</l> <l>dar pa'i chos grangs mdo' rgyud bstan <lb n="78a2"/> bcos rnams ||</l> <l>rnam dag ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i bla chen mchog |</l> <l><lb n="78a3"/> mchog gyur <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4006">dpa' ldan ral gri</rs>'i bka' la 'dud ||</l></lg> <expan>zhus s+ho</expan> || dge'o || 
         <lg><l><lb n="78a4"/> sa mtha'i dge slong <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5098">dge 'dun bzang po</rs> ngas <note type="editorial">The BDRC reads "dpang", but looking at how the letters are generally written in that page the first letter looks more like a “nga” and the second more like a “sa” the third could be a tsheg. After the first “dge'o” all the sentence are 9 syllables long.</note> ||</l> <l>thub bstan sgor zhugs sgo <lb n="78a5"/> gsum chos dang bstun ||</l> <l>bla ma'i gsung bzhin gsung rabs mang du <lb n="78a6"/> mnyan ||</l> <l>de don nyams blang dog chen grub par bsngo ||</l> </lg>
         laM lta ma || <lb n="78a7"/> || dpe 'di <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5842"><expan>slob dpon</expan> zhang</rs> gis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5541">nyang stod</rs> nas gdan drangs nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4070"><expan>blo gros</expan> seng ge</rs>s <lb n="78a8"/> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5697">brag dkar</rs> du shing phag ma <expan>bris so</expan> <note type="editorial">"shing" is unclear.</note> || 1 <expan>zhus so</expan> || dag go | dge'o |</seg></TEI>
